tenderSchedule.title: Engagement of a Consultant to prepare Detailed Project Report
tenderSchedule.description: Preparation of DPR, BOQs, technical specifications and funding documents and to provide training and implementation support for 23 Model Solar villages in Belagavi, Kalaburgi and Bengaluru Revenue Divisions

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In the seven years before the closing date, the bidder has completed at least two similar assignments of at least Rs. 5,00,000 each, or at least one similar assignment of at least Rs. 10,00,000.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form 5, with the work order and the clients completion certificate for each assignment.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average annual revenue from operations of at least Rs. 80,50,000 over the three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. Other income does not count.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form 4 certified by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN, and the audited financial statements of the three years.
Others -- Form 4 certified by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder is registered in India as a company, LLP, partnership firm, proprietary concern or society, and has a PAN and a valid GST registration.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of incorporation or registration, partnership deed or bye-laws where they apply, PAN card and GST certificate (Form 2).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder has been in operation for at least three years on the closing date.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of incorporation or registration (Form 2).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: On the closing date, the bidder is not blacklisted, debarred or suspended by any Central or State Government, PSU or statutory body, and has not changed its name or formed a new firm to escape such action.
No contract of the bidder has been terminated for default in the five years before the closing date.
The bidder is not insolvent, in receivership, bankrupt or being wound up, and its business is not suspended.
The bidder has no conflict of interest under clause 2.5.
The bidder proposes six key experts who meet the minimum qualification and experience in clause 2.3.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form 6, with the signed CV and the degree certificates of each expert.
